thread:
maria: Heads-up — customer ZeroPay is seeing a ~4x CPU spike on our q4 release build when cold-starting model shards. They filed INC-4219 and are asking for a timeline. SLA risk if we don't mitigate before 48h.
jon: Ack. Can you paste the logs/stack? Do we know whether it's a runtime or model artifact?
maria: Log snippet:
```
2026-03-16T09:12:03Z serve[pool3]: kv_cache_miss=0.87 load_avg=7.3 model_init_ms=4892 shard_load_ms=3100
ERROR grpc: downstream deadline exceeded
```
kevin: That model_init_ms looks like the quantized shard load path hitting slow I/O. We saw similar in Canary for smallbank earlier.
olivia: Which hosts are in the Dedicated pool for ZeroPay? If it's burst onto low-disk-iops instances we need to pin a faster node.
maria: Dedicated pool: redwood-dedicated-c4 (4 nodes), fallback policy routes to hosted-spot if capacity low. User is on Dedicated reserved.
andrew: If it's Dedicated, we control the infra. I can provision one NVMe-backed instance in the pool as a hotpath. ETA ~3h for node + config.
jon: We need a short-term customer-facing workaround + a longer-term fix. Customer asked for an ETA and a roll-forward plan.
maria: Proposed immediate workaround: 1) Add hotpath instance to pool, 2) Temporarily disable shard prefetching for the affected model on that tenant, 3) Canary a config change that pins requests to hotpath for t=24h. Can we do this without a release? config flag only.
kevin: Prefetch disable is a runtime flag. No code change. We can flip via /api/config/v1 for that customer only. I'll prepare the patch and the PR is #4579 — need a quick review.
olivia: I'll own the infra change (provision + routing). andrew — can you handle the instance provisioning and certs? ping when ready and I'll update routing rules.
andrew: On it. Provision started. ETA 2h 15m. Will post hostnames when ready.
jon: I'll draft the customer message. Short message: "We've identified a cold-start regression affecting specific model shards. We're provisioning a hotpath node and applying a temporary config to route you to it. Expected mitigation within 4 hours." Can someone confirm timing?
maria: Confirmed — mitigation target 4 hours from now. Action owners: infra=olivia+andrew, runtime toggle=kevin, customer comms=jon, follow-up postmortem=maria.
kevin: PR #4579 created: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4579 — needs review from @maria and @jon. It's a one-liner toggle and a rollout plan in the PR description.
maria: Reviewing now. If approved I'll coordinate the config flip and monitor p99/p95.
sre-bot: Incident INC-4219 created and linked to thread. Current severity set to P1. SLA timer started.
jon: Also need to update Release checklist: add a pre-hotstart-run to the preflight for future releases. Action for eng-releases: add item and owner.
andrew: Hotpath is up: host nvme-02.redwood.internal. Olivia, please update routing.
olivia: Routing updated to include nvme-02 with weight 1.0 for ZeroPay. Monitoring dashboards pinned.
kevin: Toggled prefetch for tenant zero-pay -> false. Observability: model_init_ms dropped from ~4.9s to ~800ms on first samples.
maria: Nice. Monitoring shows CPU drop and latency improvement. Jon — please send the customer note with ETA updated to "mitigated" and ask them to verify.
jon: Sent to customer (internal thread): "Mitigation applied; please check and confirm. We're keeping the hotpath for 24h while we work follow-up fixes." I also CC'd acct mgmt.
maria: Postmortem action items: 1) root cause triage (kevin) 2) add pre-hotstart check to release checklist (jon) 3) infra sizing guidance for Dedicated pools (olivia) 4) automated hotpath fallback when model_init_ms > 2s (andrew). I'll create a GH issue and assign.
kevin: I'll follow up with model team tomorrow to check quantization artifacts and lazy-load sequence.
jon: Thanks everyone. I'll close INC-4219 when customer confirms stable for 24h. If anything regresses ping @eng-oncall.
maria: Closing thread for now — will append postmortem link when created.
